vbScriptAutomation.sampleScript:
' Batch regenerate and post all operations
Dim ops, i
ops = Mastercam.GetOperations()
For i = 0 To UBound(ops)
  Mastercam.RegenerateOperation(ops(i))
Next
Mastercam.PostProcessAll("Generic Fanuc.pst", "C:\NC\output.nc")
